name: presentable-pass
description: A repeatable pre-share cleanup pass for a prototype before it goes out to real people — add your standard footer/attribution, then surface and fix the things that make a prototype look unfinished or fail to deploy (stale AI model ids, missing disclaimers, broken production builds, leftover boilerplate, mobile polish), and finally branch and open a PR. Use when preparing a prototype to share, adding a site-wide footer, or doing a general "clean this up and make it presentable" pass. Assumes a web app (Next.js App Router by default) but adapts to the stack it finds.
